title: "Run locally" override is ignored by the LoRA/upscale asset list - local generations blocked while a Pod is connected
description: With a Pod connected, a Klein generation was blocked by "NSFW_party_time_v2.0_klein4b.safetensors isn't installed on the remote Pod" alongside "Preparing the cloud engine...". RE-DIAGNOSED 2026-08-18: the original root cause (state.availableLoras not derived per engine) is DISPROVEN - the named file is a BAKED shipped dep (klein-lora-nsfw, klein_t2i.json node 38) that never passes through the asset list, and lora_missing_remote is a Pod-side ComfyUI value_not_in_list rejection, not the pre-dispatch guard. Two separate defects: A - a cloud dispatch was allowed for an op whose dep the Pod's ComfyUI refused, so the isOperationInstalled gate believed the Pod had a file it did not accept (stale remote install-state, or a path disagreement); B - the asset list genuinely is engine-blind (/comfy/list-files has no remote branch and re-labels local filenames with the remote separator), which is real but cannot produce this toast. Reported by Fabio 2026-08-12.
